info.title: Sorcerer Hunters (ITA)
info.synopsis: Nel continente immaginario di Spooner la cui popolazione umana è suddivisa in due classi distinte: una maggioranza priva di poteri magici chiamata Personer, vessata e schiavizzata, ed una ridotta élite di stregoni detti Sorcerer. Sotto il comando di Big Mama, una creatura magica di grande potere, agisce una squadra di cinque cacciatori di stregoni che combattono per la libertà dei Personer.

episodes.title: Il ponte delle Avances d'Amore
episodes.synopsis: Carrot and the gang are after a sorcerer who is trying to revive the dragon, Gamuru. Gamuru feeds on girls who are filled with fear, pain, and hate. Young women are being kidnapped to feed this dragon.

episodes.title: Fiore rosso, continua a risucchiare la vita
episodes.synopsis: The magic flower, Metasenia, has the power to possess the soul of a person and suck the life out of them. After it has absorbed the person's soul, it produces a being that takes on the personality of that soul. Once used to produce great soldiers, the Metasenia has since been banned. Now, there is a sorcerer who uses the flower to produce the ""perfect"" man, and it's the Sorcerer Hunters' job to stop her.

episodes.title: L'equazione della luce e dell'ombra
episodes.synopsis: This time, there is a sorcerer who is trying to build a collection. What exactly is she collecting?  And whom is Big Mama talking to in the past about all this stuff about changing the world? We uncover a sinister plot, while the Sorcerer Hunters punish an evil sorcerer.

episodes.title: I fuochi d'artificio dell'amore
episodes.synopsis: Doesn't everyone want to compete in the fireworks competition? Well, Carrot certainly does, because Bomber is waiting for him there. She has actually invited him to this fireworks competition. Of course this doesn't make Chocolate and Tira very happy. Find out what they plan to do about it.

episodes.title: Una sognatrice in riva al lago
episodes.synopsis: This is a lovely story about a boy, a girl, a woman and an old lady. Carrot, as usual, finds himself in trouble with Chocolate and Tira for chasing after some cute girl, but this time it appears that the girl actually welcomes his attention. What's going on here?

episodes.title: Permettiamo all'amore di scorrere
episodes.synopsis: Have you ever heard of the Magic River of Holy Light? There's a legend about this river and the ceremony of Spirit Rock Float. It says that you set a rock full of spirit adrift upstream, as it flows downward, the stone is bounced and scraped along the bed of the River of Holy Light. If it comes out shaped like a human being, then the rock becomes the Messiah and saves the people of the world from poverty and misfortune. Does this all make sense? Well, watch it and find out.

episodes.title: La fiamma proibita
episodes.synopsis: What happens when an evil sorcerer starts to do some good for the town? You try to find out what he is up to.  And that is just what the Sorcerer Hunters are supposed to do in this episode. An evil sorcerer is in town claiming that he is saving the town from the monsters that might attack and hurt their children. But in fact, he is doing something much worse.

episodes.title: L'eroe dei fossili
episodes.synopsis: A dragon threatens to destroy a town that's been built around him. Big Mama assigns Carrot and the gang to put the dragon to sleep for another eon or two, but an old man in the town has a scheme of his own. He wants to kill the dragon and end the town's fear once and for all. But wait, didn't Big Mama say there was no way to kill it?!

episodes.title: La divinità è folle
episodes.synopsis: The Sorcerer Hunters are called upon to defeat a beast that threatens a town, but when they arrive, they are told to cancel their mission by the very people who requested their help. What is going on here? And who is the poor woman who everyone keeps taking advantage of, tricking and abusing? Has God forsaken her?

But Big Mama is out to stop him, only someone gets in her way and confuses matters. Find out what Zaha Torte is up to. See how the Sorcerer Hunters fit into all of this.

episodes.title: Il grande ospedale dell'amore
episodes.synopsis: Poor Carrot is hurt and has to go to the hospital of love where the only staff is two very sexy young women. Suddenly Gateau finds himself sick too. Gateau comes onto Marron again. Marron turns him down again. Chocolate has a fantasy about herself being Carrot's nurse. then it is discovered that these two girls hate ALL MEN and must punish ALL MEN b-cuz they believe ALL MEN are evil. Gateau makes sure to repeat ALL MEN as much as possible. So do they save Carrrot from the women's clutches? No, he deserves it anyway.

episodes.synopsis: Zaha Torte has made a pact with a Magical Engineer. Zaha frees the engineer from the bonds that keep him from using his magic in exchange for the assassination of the Sorcerer Hunters. The mission seems suicidal; what is Zaha up to?
